conditions.zh-CN: 需要 Maton API Key（在 maton.ai 的 Settings 页获取），并先由本人在 maton.ai 网页连接要调用的各个应用。账号令牌由 Maton 保管，每次请求都经 Maton 服务器转发。
conditions.en: Requires a Maton API key (from Settings on maton.ai), and you must first connect each app you want to use on the maton.ai website. Maton holds the account tokens and relays every request through its servers.

conditions.zh-CN: 由 Teloa 代为发送请求：密钥由 Teloa 保管，只发往 https://api.maton.ai（路径由你连接的应用决定）；新增、修改、删除类请求每次先请你确认。所有 Maton 技能共用同一个 Maton API Key，填一次即可。
conditions.en: Teloa sends the requests for this skill: it keeps the key and sends it only to https://api.maton.ai (the path depends on the app you connect); every request that creates, changes or deletes data asks for your confirmation first. All Maton skills share one Maton API key, so you enter it once.

conditions.zh-CN: 正文里安装 maton 命令行工具或 maton-ai Python 包的步骤在 Teloa 中不适用；托管函数（*.maton.app）、触发器和连接管理等依赖命令行工具的功能不可用。同一应用连了多个账号时，可在请求里加 Maton-Connection 指定使用哪一个。
conditions.en: Steps that install the maton command-line tool or the maton-ai Python package do not apply in Teloa; hosted functions (*.maton.app), triggers, connection management and other features that need the command-line tool are unavailable. If you connected several accounts of the same app, add Maton-Connection to a request to choose one.

conditions.zh-CN: 单次返回内容超过 256 KiB 会被截断，非文字内容只给出省略提示。
conditions.en: Responses over 256 KiB are truncated, and non-text content is replaced by a short notice.

conditions.zh-CN: 未经 Teloa 真实账户实测：请求地址与鉴权方式按服务商官方文档和锁定版本的技能正文核对。使用中遇到问题，请在资源详情页点「问题反馈」。
conditions.en: Not tested with a real account by Teloa: request addresses and authentication were checked against the provider's official documentation and the pinned skill text. If something does not work, use Report a problem on the resource page.

label.zh-CN: Maton API Key（在 maton.ai 的 Settings 页获取）
label.en: Maton API key (from Settings on maton.ai)

httpGuide.zh-CN:
正文里的 maton api '<路径>' 命令，在 Teloa 里改用 teloa_skill_http 直接调用：url 写 https://api.maton.ai 加同一路径。
例如 maton api '/google-mail/gmail/v1/users/me/messages' 对应 GET https://api.maton.ai/google-mail/gmail/v1/users/me/messages。
查询参数要做 URL 编码；写入请求用 POST、PUT、PATCH 或 DELETE，JSON 正文放在 body，headers 写 Content-Type: application/json。
同一应用连了多个账号时，在 headers 里加一行 Maton-Connection: <连接 ID>。
不要安装或运行 maton 命令行工具与 maton-ai Python 包，也不要调用 *.maton.app 托管函数；应用连接由本人在 maton.ai 网页创建。
httpGuide.en:
Where the skill text runs maton api '<path>', call teloa_skill_http instead with the url https://api.maton.ai followed by the same path.
For example, maton api '/google-mail/gmail/v1/users/me/messages' becomes GET https://api.maton.ai/google-mail/gmail/v1/users/me/messages.
URL-encode query values; for writes use POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE with the JSON body in body and the header Content-Type: application/json.
If the same app has several connected accounts, add the header line Maton-Connection: <connection id>.
Do not install or run the maton command-line tool or the maton-ai Python package, and do not call *.maton.app hosted functions; the owner creates app connections on the maton.ai website.

httpGuide.zh-CN:

查询参数要做 URL 编码；写入请求用 POST、PUT、PATCH 或 DELETE，JSON 正文放在 body，headers 写 Content-Type: application/json。
同一应用连了多个账号时，在 headers 里加一行 Maton-Connection: <连接 ID>。

For example, maton api '/typeform/<native-api-path>' becomes GET https://api.maton.ai/typeform/<native-api-path>.
URL-encode query values; for writes use POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE with the JSON body in body and the header Content-Type: application/json.
If the same app has several connected accounts, add the header line Maton-Connection: <connection id>.
Do not install or run the maton command-line tool or the maton-ai Python package, and do not call *.maton.app hosted functions; the owner creates app connections on the maton.ai website.

httpGuide.zh-CN:
正文里的 python3 scripts/search.py 命令，在 Teloa 里改用 teloa_skill_http 调用（格式取自锁定版本 1.0.0 的 scripts/search.py）：
method POST，url https://api.x.ai/v1/responses，headers 写 Content-Type: application/json。
body：{"model":"grok-4.20-reasoning","input":[{"role":"user","content":"<搜索问题>"}],"tools":[{"type":"x_search"}]}
x_search 工具对象可加：allowed_x_handles 或 excluded_x_handles（账号列表，各最多 10 个，二者不能同时用）、from_date 与 to_date（YYYY-MM-DD）、enable_image_understanding、enable_video_understanding（true）。
返回 JSON 的 output 里有模型整理的文字与引用链接；回复时列出帖子内容、作者和原帖链接。
httpGuide.en:
Where the skill text runs python3 scripts/search.py, call teloa_skill_http instead (format taken from scripts/search.py of the pinned version 1.0.0):
method POST, url https://api.x.ai/v1/responses, headers Content-Type: application/json.
body: {"model":"grok-4.20-reasoning","input":[{"role":"user","content":"<search question>"}],"tools":[{"type":"x_search"}]}
The x_search tool object may add allowed_x_handles or excluded_x_handles (lists of up to 10 handles, not both), from_date and to_date (YYYY-MM-DD), enable_image_understanding and enable_video_understanding (true).
The output array of the JSON response holds the summarized text and citation links; present the post content, authors and links to the original posts.
